title: His Steadfast Love Endures Forever

questions.question: Give thanks to the Lord, for he is what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 136:1 (ESV): "Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good,"

questions.question: For his steadfast love endures how long?
questions.explanation: Psalm 136:1 (ESV): "for his steadfast love endures forever."

questions.question: Give thanks to the God of gods, for his steadfast love endures forever. Give thanks to the Lord of what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 136:3 (ESV): "Give thanks to the Lord of lords,"

questions.question: To him who alone does great what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 136:4 (ESV): "to him who alone does great wonders,"

questions.question: To him who by understanding made the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 136:5 (ESV): "to him who by understanding made the heavens,"

questions.question: To him who spread out the earth above the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 136:6 (ESV): "to him who spread out the earth above the waters,"

questions.question: To him who made the great lights, the sun to rule over the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 136:8 (ESV): "the sun to rule over the day,"

questions.question: The moon and stars to rule over the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 136:9 (ESV): "the moon and stars to rule over the night,"

questions.question: To him who struck down the firstborn of where?
questions.explanation: Psalm 136:10 (ESV): "to him who struck down the firstborn of Egypt,"

questions.question: And brought Israel out from among them with a strong hand and an outstretched what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 136:12 (ESV): "with a strong hand and an outstretched arm,"

questions.question: To him who divided the Red Sea in what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 136:13 (ESV): "to him who divided the Red Sea in two,"

questions.question: And made Israel pass through the midst of it, but overthrew whom in the Red Sea?
questions.explanation: Psalm 136:15 (ESV): "but overthrew Pharaoh and his host in the Red Sea,"

questions.question: To him who led his people through the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 136:16 (ESV): "to him who led his people through the wilderness,"

questions.question: He struck down great kings and killed a famous king named Og, king of where?
He gives food to all what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 136:25 (ESV): "he who gives food to all flesh,"

key_verse_text: Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good, for his steadfast love endures forever.
